semiconductor_relevance: High — Suntec Co., Ltd. specializes in precision manufacturing of critical vacuum and semiconductor components, making it relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: Suntec Co., Ltd. is a precision contract manufacturing company based in Japan, focusing on the production of ultra-high vacuum and semiconductor components. They provide CNC machining, welding, and assembly services, ensuring high precision and quality control for OEM manufacturers in various industries, including semiconductors.
capabilities: CNC machining for ultra-high vacuum components
Welding and assembly of semiconductor parts
Leak testing and chemical polishing services

regional_presence.Japan: Suntec Co., Ltd. is based in Tsuruoka City, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, where it conducts its manufacturing operations.
